selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveller want to learn when he turned his attention to the hidden world?
questions.answer: He wanted to know what that unseen world would tell him.

questions.question: What did he seem to do, in a figurative way, to begin learning from that world?
questions.answer: He was described as knocking on its door with curiosity.

questions.question: What did the traveller conclude must also happen besides showing through actions?
questions.answer: He concluded that Allah would also speak and make Himself known through speech.

questions.question: What do the many amazing works show about His qualities?
questions.answer: They show His hidden perfection and great skill.

questions.question: According to the passage, how strong is the witness of revelation compared with the witness of the universe?
questions.answer: It is stronger than the witness given by the universe and created things.

questions.question: What was ruling or dominating throughout the unseen world?
questions.answer: The truth of revelation was prevailing throughout it.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s speech?
questions.answer: It teaches that His speech fits His being, is without end, and makes both Him and His attributes known.

questions.question: What two things about Allah are made known by His speech and its meaning?
questions.answer: His very being and His attributes are made known.

questions.question: How many holy truths did the traveller understand revelation was announcing at that point?
questions.answer: He understood that it announced five sacred truths.

questions.question: What final understanding did the traveller reach at the end of this marked passage?
questions.answer: He reached the understanding that revelation declares five sacred truths.

questions.question: When the traveller reflected on the unseen world, what question was in his mind?
questions.answer: He was wondering what message that hidden world had to give.

questions.question: What did he learn from the carefully made things in the seen world?
questions.answer: He learned that their Creator is introducing Himself through them.

questions.question: Why did the traveller think speech must exist along with deeds?
questions.answer: Because One who introduces Himself through what He does would also make Himself known through words.

questions.question: Why did he believe words must also come from Allah?
questions.answer: Because One who makes Himself known by deeds would also do so by speech.

questions.question: From whom do the truths of revelation and inspiration come?
questions.answer: They come from the One who knows the unseen.

questions.question: Revelation and inspiration bring testimony about which two beliefs?
questions.answer: They testify to Allah’s existence and His oneness.

questions.question: Whose agreement made the reality of revelation very clear?
questions.answer: The agreement of one hundred thousand prophets made it very clear.

questions.question: What does Allah’s discourse make known besides its message?
questions.answer: It also makes His attributes known.

questions.question: What did the traveller understand after thinking about the prophets and the holy books?
questions.answer: He understood that revelation is clearly real and that it declares five sacred truths.

questions.question: What did the traveller do as he explored the World of the Unseen?
questions.answer: He examined it carefully and searched it with his intellect and heart.

questions.question: What signs in the visible world led him toward this search?
questions.answer: The beauty, order, blessings, and skill in creation led him toward it.

questions.question: What does “by act rather than speech” mean in this part?
questions.answer: It means showing signs through creation and blessings before speaking with words.

questions.question: How did the traveller enter the unseen world in this description?
questions.answer: He entered with his heart and saw with his intellect.

questions.question: What did he witness spreading strongly through the unseen world?
questions.answer: He witnessed the powerful reality of revelation spreading through it.
